\[
\mathrm{pH}=\mathrm{p}K_a+\lg\frac{c(\mathrm{NH_3\cdot H_2O})}{c(\mathrm{NH_4Cl})}
\]

\[
K_a=\frac{K_w}{K_b}=\frac{1.0\times10^{-14}}{1.8\times10^{-5}}
\]

\[
\mathrm{p}K_a=14-\mathrm{p}K_b=14-\left[-\lg(1.8\times10^{-5})\right]\approx 9.25
\]

\[
9.00=9.25+\lg\frac{c(\mathrm{NH_3\cdot H_2O})}{c(\mathrm{NH_4Cl})}
\]

\[
\lg\frac{c(\mathrm{NH_3\cdot H_2O})}{c(\mathrm{NH_4Cl})}=-0.25
\]

\[
\frac{c(\mathrm{NH_3\cdot H_2O})}{c(\mathrm{NH_4Cl})}\approx 0.56
\]
